title: Afternoon at the Catherdal
text:
Angili from Naturanda was a well
Informed guide, personable and very knowledgeable! Enjoyed the whole tour! Trip to the top of the tower was worth it! Don’t miss out on Cathedral if come to Seville.
author: 4-Weeks-A-Year

title: Great guide
text: Just the right amount of time and information. Tower is 33 flights  and maybe not worth the energy for older people. Very knowledgeable guide.
author: Hilary_P

title: Wonderful Cathedral and Giralda
text: Beautiful experience. The Cathedral and the Giralda are fabulous and our guide was very good at describing everything to us very clearly, making the whole tour interesting.
author: Nicola_F

title: The guide offers us...
text: The guide offers us very interesting historical facts throughout the tour. Visual aid to help us understand the construction of the church.
author: alex_p

title: Tours to do
text: Not to be missed is worth it. Experienced and very good guide. Precise and reliable tour operators. I recommend it
author: Giovanni_M

title: Alejandro was our guide...
text: Alejandro was our guide and he did a great job! Totally worth doing this since tickets to the cathedral were not easy to find at the time of our visit. It was great to see this with a guide who knew the history and pointed out the most interesting parts. Word to the wise- there are a lot of stairs going up to the bell tower so be ready!! Overall a good time and a excellent deal
author: Eliza_F

title: Amazing
text: Amazing experience, full of history, culture and views. Every where you look different enjoyment!!! Well worth the visit!
author: markdA3957UU

title: Pleasant
text: Very thoughtful and accommodating tour company!
author: Katherine B

title: Excellent tour guide & company
text: Besides the tour being entertaining and informative, they were very accommodating to our (slight) tardiness. I read the time wrong and they called us to check in, and I appreciate them so much for doing that! Also, I didn't realize when I booked, but the tour includes tickets to the tower which had some stunning views. Recommend!!
author: StephiP1313

title: Cathedral and Giralda Walking Tour.
text: Paola was our guide.  She was fabulous. Very knowledgeable and very happy to answer any questions posed by the group. All in all an excellent tour and I would highly recommend it. The time flew by so quickly.
author: carolkI7004NB
